# bioexcel/biobb_structure_utils/structure_check

## Summary

This class is a wrapper of the Structure Checking tool to generate summary checking results on a json file.

Wrapper for the Structure Checking tool to generate summary checking results on a json file from a given structure and a list of features.

Nextflow adapter of the [StructureCheck](https://biobb-structure-utils.readthedocs.io/en/latest/utils.html#module-utils.structure_check) building block of [biobb_structure_utils](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_structure_utils) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_STRUCTURE_UTILS_STRUCTURE_CHECK } from 'bioexcel/biobb_structure_utils/structure_check'

workflow {
    BIOBB_STRUCTURE_UTILS_STRUCTURE_CHECK(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_structure_path` | yes | pdb, pdbqt | Input structure file path |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_summary_path` | yes | json | Output summary checking results |
| `versions_biobb_structure_utils` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_structure_utils', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of StructureCheck properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_summary_path: 'json']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_structure_utils container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_STRUCTURE_UTILS_STRUCTURE_CHECK' {
        ext.properties = [features: 'models']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `features` | array | null | Features to summarize. If None, all the features will be computed. Values: models, chains, altloc, metals, ligands, chiral, getss, cistransbck, backbone, amide, clashes. |
| `binary_path` | string | "check_structure" | path to the check_structure application |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
